about_the_game:
One morning, you wake up with a dream under the colorful lights of Akihabara: to open a small cafe of your own. With a little capital and a lot of passion, your goal is far from simple to build Japan’s most beloved maid cafe. In this game, every little detail will take shape through your touch.

Start with a single floor, a couple of tables, and a handful of maids. As the days pass, your cafe grows into something much more: a lively stage for performances, themed nights, and unforgettable customer experiences.

Features

  • Decorate and Design
    Customize your café with tables, lights, wallpapers, and props. Create an atmosphere that customers will love and employees will thrive in.

  • Menus & Pricing
    Balance taste, presentation, and price to attract more customers while keeping your profits steady.

  • Maid Training & Performances
    Hire and train staff with unique personalities. Unlock special skills such as dance shows, magic tricks, and playful interactions that keep your guests entertained.

  • Customer Experience
    Otaku, tourists, businesspeople, or families each group has different expectations. Deliver fast service, stage events, or offer unique mini-games to keep them happy.

  • Social Media & Events
    Go viral! Plan posts, promote your café online, and organize cosplay nights, idol events, or seasonal celebrations that boost your popularity and reputation.

  • Growth & Challenges
    As your cafe expands, managing stock, staff morale, and customer feedback becomes more demanding. A single bad decision can cost you your reputation but smart strategies can turn your café into a nationwide brand.

name: Maid Cafe Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Maid Cafe Simulator is a fun cafe management simulation that will immerse you in the heart of Japanese pop culture. Build your dream maid cafe, train your maids, design your menu, and win over your customers!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
